cohort: 55 pregnant women suspected of having COVID-19
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 often show specific radiological features on chest X-rays and CT scans, which are highly sensitive for diagnosing COVID-19, although the refusal rate for imaging was high due to concerns about radiation exposure.
mod_finding: This study found that the preterm birth and cesarean section rates were remarkably increased in pregnant women with COVID-19.
